messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly pulse for Sierra — small onboarding cohort update. usage steady, costs +4% MoM, error rate up ~0.2pp. main concern is p99 spikes on a couple routes earlier this week.

ashley_eng: Can you paste the p95/p99 breakouts by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming? I want to check if this matches the autoscaler traces.

maria_cs: pasted below (pulled from telemetry for 2024-04-28 to 2024-05-04):
```
/api/generate  — redwood-13b:
  streaming: p95=230ms, p99=940ms
  non-stream: p95=420ms, p99=1.6s

/api/chat  — gptx-7b:
  streaming: p95=180ms, p99=520ms
  non-stream: p95=390ms, p99=1.1s

/embeddings  — small-embed-2:
  streaming: N/A
  non-stream: p95=85ms, p99=190ms
```
(also saw ~3.5% 5xxs concentrated on /api/generate around 2024-05-01 03:10 UTC)

raj_support: Noted. The p99 gap between streaming and non-streaming on /api/generate looks big — could be tail due to batching latency when cache misses happen. Did they enable prefix cache on that route?

maria_cs: @raj_support, client said they turned on long context caching last week. I can confirm config, but logs show cache miss bursts aligning with p99 spikes.

devops-bot: deploy: service/redwood-runtime v2.8.1 promoted to prod at 2024-05-01T03:05:12Z — triggered rolling restarts on a subset of dedicated nodes.

ashley_eng: That timing matches. Rolling restarts can cause transient KV-cache warmups and slow non-stream requests more (because streaming can serve early partial tokens). Suggest we: 1) check node warmup metrics, 2) add small buffer pool for hot KV segments, 3) recommend client enable streaming for /api/generate for lower tail latency.

maria_cs: Action items:
- ashley_eng to check node warmup and confirm if restart correlates with missing cache (owner: ashley_eng, ETA: EOD today)
- raj_support to draft fallback policy (auto-route to streaming variant when non-stream p99 > 1s for >3min) (owner: raj_support, ETA: Tue)
- maria_cs to sync with Sierra PM for enablement + cost note (owner: maria_cs, ETA: tomorrow)

oliver_sierra: Thanks team — the spike hit our search generate flow and we saw a few customer sessions time out. Can we set a short weekly check-in to avoid surprises? :raising_hand:  Prefer Tue mornings.

maria_cs: noted — I'll add a recurring 30m slot for Tuesdays 09:00 PT. Also will share a short one-pager with the numbers and recommended quick mitigations (streaming enablement + transient retry knobs). :thumbsup:

ashley_eng: I ran a quick sim on staging: enabling streaming reduced simulated p99 by ~45% for that workload. Will share the runbook for customers that want a fast toggle.

raj_support: Also adding a small metric alert: "nonstream_p99 > 1s for 3m" -> page CS on first hit and mute after 2 alerts in 24h. Keeps noise low but surfaces real regressions.

oliver_sierra: Appreciate it. We'll prepare to flip streaming on a canary subset tomorrow and report back.

maria_cs: closing the loop here — follow-ups in the recurring sync. Thanks all. :v:
